name: Syn Prop & Tech S.A.
summary: Syn Prop & Tech S.A. have a deep understanding of the Brazilian commercial real estate market. Their business is to make clients lives easier so they can focus on their own businesses. Syn Prop & Tech S.A. serve various market segments, including shopping malls, commercial buildings, and warehouses. Their services encompass leasing and management, as well as buying and selling commercial properties. Their team consists of experts in management, projects, engineering, security, technology, and business, with experience, autonomy, and a lot of talent for innovation to deliver the best solutions. Syn Prop & Tech S.A. dedicate themselves to ensuring that companies and retailers feel at ease, achieve their goals, and thrive. Syn Prop & Tech S.A. work behind the scenes, taking care of people's experiences in SYN spaces while they work, shop, and have fun. Syn Prop & Tech S.A. was incorporated in 1962 in Brazil.
